verdict.rationale: Factory documents a 'Bring Your Own Machine' feature letting engineering leads register their own VPS, workstation, or on-prem server as a Droid Computer, and the Droid CLI can run locally in a terminal — both point toward local/VM self-hosting of agent execution. However, there's no evidence of a containerized deployment option or of self-hosting the full control plane (session management, Missions orchestration, App backend), which appear to remain Factory-hosted SaaS components. Missing for 10: explicit container/Docker deployment support, self-hosted control-plane/orchestration option, and independent confirmation that BYOM fully replaces cloud-hosted session management.
